name: Chocolope
summary: **Chocolope** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:DNA Genetics]] in Amsterdam, [[country:NL|Netherlands]], by crossing an [[chocolate-thai|Original Chocolate Thai]] female with a [[cannalope-haze|Cannalope Haze]] male and backcrossing to shorten flowering time. Originally named D-Line, it was awarded High Times' Strain of the Year in 2007.
